q1: SELECT name FROM drinker WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT f.bar FROM frequents AS f, serves AS s WHERE f.drinker = drinker.name AND f.bar = s.bar AND NOT s.beer IN (SELECT beer FROM likes WHERE drinker = drinker.name))
